description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceModelCatalog component, verifying its symbol generation logic for different device models and presentation behavior.

methods.name: `symbol prefers model identifier prefixes`
methods.description: Tests that the symbol method returns the correct prefix based on device family and model identifier.

methods.name: `symbol uses friendly name for mac variants`
methods.description: Tests that the symbol method uses the friendly name mapping for Mac devices.

methods.name: `symbol falls back to device family`
methods.description: Tests that the symbol method defaults to device family when model identifier and friendly name are not provided.

methods.name: `presentation uses bundled model mappings`
methods.description: Verifies that the presentation method returns the correct presentation title for a given device model.
